g.text: How much is known differs enormously between owners

g.text: What it shows: Epoch's published 5th-95th percentile beside each owner's median at 2025Q4. Every other chart in this

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: domain plots the dot; this is the bar it sits on, and the bar is not the same width for everyone.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Epoch AI, AI Chip Owners (CC-BY) — cumulative_by_designer.csv — epoch.ai/data/ai-chip-owners

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows Epoch AI's published AI chip owners documentation

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: The interval runs from 0.00 times the median for xAI to 1.96 times for China (smuggled) — the least and most observable holdings in

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: the set. Smuggled capacity is by nature the hardest to see, and Epoch says so by widening the interval rather than by leaving it out.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: "Other", "China" and "China (smuggled)" are aggregates rather than organisations, and are labelled so no reading treats them as one
